reading.title: The Impact of Renewable Energy on Global Economics
reading.passage: Renewable energy sources such as solar and wind power have become increasingly important in the global economy. Unlike fossil fuels, renewable energy produces electricity without generating greenhouse gases, making it environmentally sustainable. Countries investing in renewable energy infrastructure have experienced job creation and reduced energy costs over time. However, the initial investment required for solar panels and wind turbines remains substantial, which challenges developing nations. Despite these obstacles, experts predict that renewable energy will account for 50% of global electricity by 2050, fundamentally transforming how societies produce and consume energy.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is a key advantage of renewable energy compared to fossil fuels?
options: A) It requires less maintenance
B) It produces electricity without generating greenhouse gases
C) It is cheaper to install immediately
D) It creates fewer jobs
questions.explanation: 지문에서 'renewable energy produces electricity without generating greenhouse gases'라고 명시되어 있습니다. 다른 선택지들은 지문에서 언급되지 않거나 거짓입니다.

questions.q: What challenge does the passage mention regarding renewable energy development in developing nations?
options: A) Lack of wind and sunlight
B) Environmental concerns
C) The substantial initial investment required
D) Lack of skilled workers
questions.explanation: 'However, the initial investment required for solar panels and wind turbines remains substantial, which challenges developing nations'에서 초기 투자 비용이 도전 과제임을 알 수 있습니다.

questions.q: What does the passage predict about renewable energy's role by 2050?
options: A) It will completely replace fossil fuels
B) It will account for 50% of global electricity
C) It will become more expensive
D) It will be abandoned by most countries
questions.explanation: 지문의 마지막 문장에서 '재생에너지가 2050년까지 전 세계 전기의 50%를 차지할 것'이라고 명시되어 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? 'Renewable energy should be the primary focus of government investment rather than traditional energy sources.' Provide specific reasons and examples to support your position.

structure.intro: 명확한 입장 표시: '동의한다/동의하지 않는다'를 직접 명시하고, 주요 논거 2-3개를 간단히 소개합니다.
structure.body1: 첫 번째 이유를 구체적인 예시와 함께 전개합니다. 환경 오염, 에너지 비용, 일자리 창출 등의 관점에서 서술할 수 있습니다.
structure.body2: 두 번째 이유를 제시합니다. 기술 발전, 장기적 경제성, 에너지 안보 등을 다룰 수 있습니다. 반대 입장의 논거도 인정하되 반박합니다.
structure.conclusion: 서론에서 제시한 주요 논거들을 요약하고 최종 결론을 명확히 표시합니다. 미래 영향에 대한 간단한 전망으로 마무리합니다.

speaking.prompt: Some people believe that technology has improved our quality of life. Others think technology has made our lives more stressful and complicated. Which perspective do you agree with? Provide specific reasons and examples.
sample_points: 기술은 의료, 교육, 통신 등 다양한 분야에서 생활의 편의성을 크게 향상시켰고, 원격 근무와 온라인 학습 등 새로운 기회를 제공하고 있습니다.
반면 기술 의존도 증가로 인한 스트레스, 개인정보 침해, 수면 부족 등의 부작용도 존재하며, 이러한 부작용을 관리하기 위한 균형 잡힌 접근이 필요합니다.

listening.title: Campus Sustainability Initiative Discussion
listening.script: Professor Johnson: Good morning, everyone. I wanted to discuss our university's new sustainability initiative. We're planning to install solar panels on three campus buildings this fall. Student: That sounds interesting, Professor. How much will that cost? Professor Johnson: The initial investment is about 2 million dollars, but we expect to recover that cost within eight years through reduced electricity bills. Plus, we'll reduce our carbon footprint by approximately 40 percent. Student: That's impressive. Will students be involved in this project? Professor Johnson: Absolutely! We need student volunteers to help with awareness campaigns and monitoring energy usage in dormitories. We're also offering internships for students interested in renewable energy and environmental studies. Student: I'd definitely like to be involved. What's the timeline? Professor Johnson: Construction begins in September and should be completed by December. After that, we'll hold an educational workshop series to explain how the system works and why sustainability matters for our future.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the conversation?
options: A) To discuss the university's new sustainability initiative with solar panel installation
B) To recruit students for a summer internship program
C) To explain why electricity bills have increased
D) To cancel the planned construction project
questions.explanation: 교수가 캠퍼스 지속 가능성 이니셔티브와 태양광 패널 설치 계획에 대해 논의하고 있습니다. 이것이 대화의 주요 목적입니다.

questions.q: According to Professor Johnson, what is the expected benefit of installing solar panels?
options: A) Immediate cost reduction within one year
B) A 40% reduction in carbon footprint and cost recovery within eight years
C) Elimination of all energy costs
D) No significant environmental impact
questions.explanation: 교수는 '8년 내에 비용을 회수하고 탄소 발자국을 약 40% 감소시킬 것으로 예상한다'고 명시했습니다.

questions.q: How will students be involved in the sustainability project?
options: A) Only through class assignments
B) Through volunteer awareness campaigns, energy monitoring, and internship opportunities
C) By paying additional fees
D) They will not be involved
questions.explanation: 교수는 학생들이 인식 제고 캠페인, 에너지 사용 모니터링 그리고 인턴십을 통해 참여할 수 있다고 설명했습니다.
